name: prune_summary

test_list.description: Summary output stays within the configured character limit.
Control and zero-width characters are removed deterministically.
Markdown delimiters and HTML tags are removed from the remote summary text.
Instruction-like prefixes are neutralized before S1 sees the summary.
The same tool metadata always yields the same sanitized summary.

inputs.name: max_chars
inputs.description: Maximum output size in Unicode scalar values.

output_description: A deterministic bounded string with control characters and Markdown/HTML markup removed and a clear untrusted-metadata prefix.
